subject: City Record Agency Rules multi-notice rulemaking stitch after lookback widen

lookback.note: Prior 14-day materialization almost never co-located proposal/hearing/adoption siblings; multi_notice_rulemakings stayed 0 on live.

false_merge.definition: Multi-notice group whose mean pairwise title-core overlap is below RULEMAKING_TITLE_OVERLAP_MIN (0.55), or size>8 with pair-match density < 0.85. Confidence thresholds were NOT lowered; title-core noise strip was tightened so wider window does not chain-merge DCWP house-style titles.
false_merge.verdict: Low false-merge rate under proxy; residual clusters reviewed in audits (often phased program notices, e.g. commercial waste zones).

restaurant_vs_car_wash_must_not_merge.basis: title-core overlap too low (0%) or missing dates
